evidence: In the base, the loop assigned reason on every iteration. When no candidate was eligible, reason held the last candidate's reason, but the finding named candidates[0]. That mismatch is the bug this commit fixes.
In the head, reason is recomputed from candidates[0] after the loop. It is reached only when no candidate is eligible, so the reason is non-empty and matches the named memory.
Eligible and single-candidate cases behave as before. The new test case checks that memory 7 is named with its own 'not pinned and has no topic_key' reason, not memory 8's reason.
The calls to IneligibleReason are pure, so computing the reason twice has no side effects. I found no defect caused by this change.
